screens.title: 项目概览
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished high-fidelity desktop web application prototype screen, not a collage, not a diagram, not a photo. Landscape 16:10 composition, ideally 2400 x 1500, straight-on full application screenshot with crisp readable Simplified Chinese typography.
Reference image role: the attached existing CodeMinificationRepository screenshot is a structural/style reference only. Preserve the AutoOps cube wordmark, left application navigation, thin-line Lucide-like icons, compact controls, neutral typography and restrained information density. Extend it with the actual Solid Glass theme: cool very pale gray background, near-white translucent panels with a fine white rim, subtle layered shadows, 18px outer corner radii and 10px control radii. Use dark charcoal solid primary buttons, fine gray outline secondary buttons, quiet ghost icon buttons. Green only for healthy states, amber only for draft/waiting, no decorative gradients, no vivid blue primary, no dark theme. This is a practical Chinese engineering console, not a marketing page.
Common shell identical across all screens: left sidebar approximately 216px in a 1440px reference grid, top wordmark AutoOps and small gray label 项目工作台; project selector SOL 标准版. Navigation in this exact order: 项目概览, 资料与配置, 服务与部署, MCP 与连接, 项目工具, Agent 对话. Lower sidebar has 我的主机 and 项目成员; footer avatar T and 陶涛, 项目管理员. Main top header breadcrumb 项目 / SOL 标准版 / current page, right 测试 environment selector and small avatar. Do not show a workflow navigation entry. Main area compact but breathable with real useful content, fine separators, white space, no oversized metric badges. Use exact requested short Chinese labels. No browser chrome, no annotations outside app, no decorative device frame. All data are illustrative.

Current page 项目概览, active nav 项目概览.
Main header title SOL 标准版, small subtitle 项目资料、服务与工具，集中管理. Right outline button 管理资料 and dark button 开始问答.
Under title a quiet slim information row 测试环境 / 项目配置 v12 · 已生效 / 团队成员 8 人. Avoid KPI tiles.
Upper main layout about 65% width a 服务与部署 panel, 35% width a 项目资料 panel.
Service panel contains three clean equally sized compact service rows/cards without heavy nesting: API 服务 with green 运行中, branch main, commit 38e20cf and constant copy icon, server 测试服务器 A; Web 控制台 with green 运行中, main, commit 7bd120a; 设备网关 with green 运行中, release, commit 93ac721. Each has an arrow on service name and appropriate small 更新 button. Header has 全部服务 ↗. Footer a quiet single line 最近发布 · 今天 14:20 · API 服务更新成功.
Project materials panel lists 研发设计 / 12 份资料, 代码仓库 / 后端与前端, 最新源码 / main · 38e20cf, 脱敏资料包 / v12 · 可用于问答. A subtle single link 查看资料与产物 ↗.
Lower main layout same balanced columns: left 项目工具 with three horizontal rows: 设备路由 cabinet-router 已启用 with 打开 ↗ and 配置链接; 接口调试 已启用 with 打开 ↗; 日志分析 未启用 with switch off. Link 管理项目工具. Do not put editable configuration fields here.
Right 可用 Agent with three rows: 项目助手 / 服务器内置 / green 可用; 代码顾问 / Codex · 陶涛的主机 / green 可用; 设计助手 / Claude Code · 团队主机 / green 可用. Small button 选择 Agent.
Bottom small recent activity two lines: 14:20 发布 API 服务成功; 13:42 生成脱敏源码包 v12. Footer faint 原型预览 · 示例数据.
Content must feel uncluttered, premium, consistent with existing engineering UI.
